user.title: Pair with Ohmter
user.description: In your Ohmter dashboard open Settings, then Home Assistant, and choose Pair a Home Assistant. Type the code it shows you here. It is valid for ten minutes and works once. No password is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with Ohmter
reauth_confirm.description: Ohmter disconnected this Home Assistant. Make a new pairing code in your Ohmter dashboard and type it here. Your devices and their history are kept.

error.bad_code: That code is not valid. Check it in your Ohmter dashboard.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Make a new one in your Ohmter dashboard.
error.cannot_connect: Ohmter could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant is already paired with Ohmter.

menu_options.add_device: Add a device for Ohmter to see

add_device.title: What kind of device?
add_device.description: Ohmter controls chargers and thermostats. Meters, inverters and batteries are read only: Ohmter uses them to plan, never to steer.

map_entities.title: Which entities?
map_entities.description: Pick the entities of this {kind} from your Home Assistant. Ohmter only ever receives the entities you choose here.

error.name_too_short: Give the device a name of at least two characters.
error.name_taken: A device with this name already exists.
error.same_entity_twice: The same entity is picked for two roles.

bridge_revoked.title: Ohmter disconnected this Home Assistant
bridge_revoked.description: This bridge was disconnected from the Ohmter dashboard. Ohmter no longer sends commands. To connect again, make a new pairing code in Ohmter and re-pair the integration.

bridge_conflict.title: Two Home Assistants are using the same Ohmter pairing
bridge_conflict.description: Another Home Assistant instance (a restored backup, perhaps) is reporting with this bridge's token. Ohmter sends no commands until only one remains. Remove the integration from the copy you do not use, then pair this one again.
